تلتحقين (form VIII)
# تَلْتَحِقِينَ (taltaḥiqīna) /tal.ta.ħi.qiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# تُلْتَحَقِينَ (tultaḥaqīna) /tul.ta.ħa.qiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
